## 2026-11-01 — S1830: R'-level (G2) and (G3) proved; S1825 residual G2/G3 closed

- [proof complete; both S1779 missing fields discharged]
  tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1830G2G3RPrimeActual.lean:
  S1830QuotientsMissing : S1779QuotientsMissing and
  S1830MonoMissing : S1779MonoMissing, hence
  S1830AlgPreGaloisMissing : S1779AlgPreGaloisMissing and
  S1830PreGaloisCategory : PreGaloisCategory S1779AlgR.
  G2 uses FiniteEtaleFixedPointsGeneral.fixedPointSubalgebra_finiteEtale
  (arbitrary commutative ring, Galois descent along a finite faithfully flat
  etale splitting cover); G3 uses epi -> surjective, idempotent-kernel
  splitting, and the product fan limit in the full subcategory of finite etale
  algebras.  R' is not a field and the field-case S1746/S1770/S1785/S1811
  arguments are not used.
- [consumer] _S1830Consumer.lean compiles EXIT=0 and derives
  PreGaloisCategory S1728Cover from e : S1825AffineEquiv using S1825's
  S1825PreGaloisCategory_of_missing; S1825AlgPreGaloisMissing is inhabited.
  The remaining S1825 inputs are the affine equivalence (S1777/S1778) and the
  geometric fibre functor (S1779FiberFunctorMissing), not G2/G3.
- [evidence] source 26936 bytes, SHA256
  4DD1A4199904D09D137C40E94A4C3D0732911E96438454B5B85E2E69D20871F2;

  Quot.sound only.  Report: coord/reports/S1830-g2-g3-rprime-actual.md.

## S1907 (2026-11-01): Serre large image on E'/F' -- no Lean port, precise first missing

**Result: MISSING (no fake).** tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1907SerreLargeImageActual.lean (EXIT=0;
axioms propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only; no sorry, no new axiom; source
SHA256 47EA7838066E165CD084E4BA76B51B408ED7FD553675D1163C67AF3A130C9B94;
olean 102768 bytes SHA256
DCA447166D874B33B12C9745FFAE46C9CD84274AC28D84905EEBD6CBE9EE4C18) records the
uniform target `∀ l ≥ 5, SerreStyleLargeImageStatement S1720Curve l`, proves
`Uniform ↔ ∃ l0, Cofinite l0 ∧ Small l0` and
`(∃ l0, Cofinite l0) ↔ Set.Finite {l | ¬ target}`, and defines the two
missing inputs: `S1907FirstMissing` (only finitely many exceptional
primes; Serre open image / [GenEll] Thm 3.8) and `S1907FiniteVerification`
(explicit mod-l image computation below the threshold, in particular l = 5).
No Lean port was located: Mathlib v4.32.2 has no Tate module / Galois
representation / Faltings height / open-image theorem; TauCeti has the Tate
module over separably closed fields, Serre's local lemma and potential good
reduction, but no global open-image theorem; the tree's audit cards
`IUT-I.elliptic-l-torsion-large-image` and
`Foundations.Geometry.elliptic-tate-uniformization` are pending;
the `tmp/external` IUT ports contain only source-hypothesis shapes.
[GenEll] Thm 3.8 does not cover l=5 (condition (b) excludes 2*3*5; condition
(a) is >= 23040 for a fixed curve), so the uniform statement needs the finite
check in addition to open image.
